title: Buy Two Chocolates
description:
You are given:

An array prices → cost of chocolates
An integer money → your budget
Task
You must buy exactly 2 chocolates
Total cost must be ≤ money (no debt)
Among all valid pairs, choose the pair with the minimum total cost
Output
Return:
money - (cost of chosen 2 chocolates)
If you cannot buy 2 chocolates without exceeding money, return:
money
Examples

Example 1

prices = [1,2,2], money = 3
→ 0

Example 2

prices = [3,2,3], money = 3
→ 3
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
The third line contains an integer.
